changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE estimate_rate_decisions ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique_equipment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES unique_equipment(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, operation_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, -- категория операции (то/осмотр/замена…) operation_name TEXT, -- как названо в смете/эталоне rate_code VARCHAR(64), rate_name TEXT, periodicity VARCHAR(200), per_year NUMERIC(6,2), correction NUMERIC(6,3), source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REFERENCE', -- REFERENCE / APPROVED times_used INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_decision UNIQUE (unique_equipment_id, operation_key) ); CREATE INDEX idx_decision_equipment ON estimate_rate_decisions(unique_equipment_id);
